title: Prediction
description: Predict whether a re-render is automatically a performance bug.
prompt: A component function runs again after its state changes. What does that usually mean?

options.label: React is recalculating the UI for the new state.
The component has a performance bug because it rendered again.
The component state will reset to its initial value.

responses.normal-react-update: Correct. Re-rendering after state changes is normal React behavior. The performance question is whether the render does expensive or unnecessary work.
responses.performance-bug: Not quite. A re-render can be completely normal. It becomes interesting only when it causes meaningful user-visible cost.
responses.state-reset: Not quite. React preserves state for the component instance across normal re-renders.

metadata.reason: Catches the misconception that every re-render is automatically bad.
